authority.freeze_identity_rule: The frozen source is the PR #57 head at final pre-run review, identified by the annotated tag microstructure-freeze-v8 (git rev-parse microstructure-freeze-v8^{commit}). Authorisation does not move this head: it is granted by a receipt naming the reviewed tag and SHA, and the gate verifies every tracked file on disk against the blobs committed at that SHA, so the reviewed source and the executed source are the same bytes. CI publishes an evidence artifact named microstructure-mechanism-contract-<that sha>, which is corroboration for a reader; the gate does not read it and nothing in the run depends on it. Tags v1 to v7 identify superseded documents.
authority.append_only_depends_on_tag_immutability: The validator proves the amendment log is append-only by comparing it with the contract committed at microstructure-freeze-v7. That guarantee is only as strong as the immutability of that tag in the authoritative repository: in a clone one controls, force-moving v7 to the current head makes the check pass vacuously, because the previous document becomes the current one and any content extends itself. Nothing in this repository can prove an upstream tag has not been moved. The append-only property therefore rests on repository governance as well as on code, and is stated here rather than implied.

implementation_defects_corrected.fix: Exact integer arithmetic: floor = (demand*size)//total, remainder key = (demand*size) % total.

implementation_defects_corrected.fix: Cancel and replace to full display size when resting quantity falls below target, which is the correct exchange semantics for a top-up.
implementation_defects_corrected.verified: Displayed size at each placement is the full target; the residual shortfall is the latency window between a fill and the replacement landing. See residual_asymmetry for the replacement-frequency figure and its reproducer.
implementation_defects_corrected.residual_asymmetry: The fix equalises displayed size at placement but not replacement frequency. Each episode resets queue position and costs a latency window, so time-to-fill comparisons inherit it. The arms measure it in different units, lots against a fraction, and the contract states in terms that it is never differenced. The table would have carried a meaningless number into a reviewed artifact. No test covered it because the fixture used only the two metrics where differencing is valid.
implementation_defects_corrected.fix: The metrics that may not be differenced are a machine-readable list in the contract; the table reports those side by side, with a note, and no difference column.
implementation_defects_corrected.verified: A test builds the table for the queue measure and asserts no difference column appears, and that the descriptive-only note does.

implementation_defects_corrected.defect: The committed canonical seed set was cached on first use, including when the read failed. One transient git error at process start silently disabled that layer for the life of the process.
implementation_defects_corrected.fix: Only a successful read is cached.
implementation_defects_corrected.verified: A test fails the first read, restores git, and asserts the second call returns the real set.

implementation_defects_corrected.defect: The frozen-seed grant was keyed on the contract id and the file digest, both of which dataclasses.replace copies unchanged. A derived configuration with an arbitrary scale, horizon or seed set inherited the authorisation. replace is used three times in this package, so this is ordinary code rather than a contrivance.
implementation_defects_corrected.fix: The grant is keyed on a digest of the configuration itself.
implementation_defects_corrected.verified: A test grants the real configuration, then shows three derived ones are refused while carrying the same id and file digest.

implementation_defects_corrected.defect: The required run fields and emitted artifacts were checked only against a list inside the validator. Nothing compared either with what the code produces, so a field could stop being emitted with no test or validator signal. That is how the record digest went undelivered from the freeze onwards, and the fix for it left the same direction unchecked.
implementation_defects_corrected.fix: Tests compare the contract's lists with a real run record and with the artifacts the run writes.
implementation_defects_corrected.verified: Removing a required field from the record fails the first test; removing an artifact write fails the second.

implementation_defects_corrected.defect: The amendment coverage check treated any range as covering the amendments inside it, so a single line naming the whole span satisfied it for every amendment at once. The check introduced to close narrative drift could itself be satisfied vacuously.
implementation_defects_corrected.fix: A range wide enough to swallow the log does not count as a summary.
implementation_defects_corrected.verified: A test asserts a blanket range fails while a genuine grouping passes.

implementation_defects_corrected.defect: The test covering the tree walk did not test half of what it named. It tried to corrupt two files by replacing a substring that appears in one of them and not the other, so the second edit was a silent no-op, and the test passed on Windows only because writing the text back rewrote the line endings. On a checkout that does not, the assertion would have failed, and the assume-unchanged bypass had no coverage at all.
implementation_defects_corrected.fix: The test appends bytes, which changes every file and is independent of newline translation, and asserts the edit landed before relying on it.
implementation_defects_corrected.verified: The test fails if either update-index bypass stops being caught.

implementation_defects_corrected.defect: The test binding the decision metric to the contract searched the source text of the decision rule. Splitting the literal in two and adding a dead reference to the contract field passed it.
implementation_defects_corrected.fix: A behavioural test varies the named metric and asserts the reported statistic and metric follow it.
implementation_defects_corrected.verified: Reverting the decision rule to a hardcoded metric, however spelled, changes neither statistic and fails the test.

implementation_defects_corrected.defect: The check on the executing package proved only that it sat somewhere inside the reviewed worktree. A complete second copy at microstructure-sim/build/lib/mechsim satisfied that, and the scan for unreviewed importable files covered the source root alone, leaving build, egg-info and the tests' caches unexamined by both it and git. The editable install puts a .pth file outside the repository holding the path that is actually imported, and nothing reviewed or hashed it, so repointing it substituted the whole package including this gate.
implementation_defects_corrected.fix: The executing package must be the reviewed copy at its canonical path, and the scan covers the whole project directory.
implementation_defects_corrected.verified: A test refuses the real repository's package against a throwaway contract, and refuses a second copy planted inside the worktree under an ignored directory while git reports the tree clean.

implementation_defects_corrected.defect: The test that was supposed to check the declared artifacts against what the code produces searched the module for each filename as a quoted string. Deleting the write and leaving the name in a comment passed it, which an audit demonstrated. The fix recorded in D45 closed this direction for the run record and left it open for the artifacts, and the defect's own verification text said otherwise.
implementation_defects_corrected.fix: The artifacts are written by a function the test calls, and the test reads the directory afterwards.
implementation_defects_corrected.verified: Removing a write leaves the file absent and fails the test, which now inspects the filesystem rather than the source.

implementation_defects_corrected.defect: The narrative said eleven defects would have invalidated the comparison while the contract's severity fields marked fourteen. The sentence was edited in the same commit that added three more invalidating defects, and the edit silently failed to match, so the number stood wrong in both documents. Nothing read the count.
implementation_defects_corrected.fix: The count is corrected and the validator cross-foots the stated number against the severity fields in both documents, and requires every invalidating defect to be named in the findings.
implementation_defects_corrected.verified: A test drifts the prose and the severity fields in turn and confirms each direction is refused.

implementation_defects_corrected.defect: The latency plot accepted any metric. Handing it the queue measure produced a chart titled PRO_RATA minus FIFO of a quantity in lots against one that is a fraction, the comparison the contract forbids. Nothing reached it that way in the current pipeline, but the table had been taught the rule and its neighbour in the same module had not.
implementation_defects_corrected.fix: The plot refuses a metric the contract lists as not differenced across mechanisms.
implementation_defects_corrected.verified: A test asserts the refusal and that the permitted metric still plots.

implementation_defects_corrected.defect: The cache added to stop a failed read being remembered was unreachable. The success path returned from inside the try block, so the store below it ran only in the failure branch where the result was always empty; nothing was ever cached in either direction. The test written for it asserted that a failed read was absent from the cache, which was true because the cache was always empty.
implementation_defects_corrected.fix: The cache is removed. Every call reads fresh, which is the behaviour the fix was reaching for.
implementation_defects_corrected.verified: A test asserts no cache attribute exists, that the read is not an lru_cache, and that a failing read between two successful ones changes neither.

implementation_defects_corrected.defect: Negative zero printed as -0 in the comparison table and the plot's axis labels, because the guard against collapsing a small number to zero tested inequality with 0.0, which is false for -0.0. An exact zero read as a small negative, the mirror image of the defect the guard was added for.
implementation_defects_corrected.fix: Zero is formatted as zero whatever its sign.
implementation_defects_corrected.verified: A test covers -0.0, 0.0 and values below the precision threshold.

research_question: Under an identical prespecified synthetic order-flow realization and latency model, how do price-time priority and pro-rata allocation differ in execution quality and queue outcomes for a tracked passive parent order?

hypotheses.null: Allocation mechanism has no effect on the decision metric at the matched-latency baseline.

A.name: price-time priority
A.allocation: resting orders filled in (price, arrival_sequence) order

B.name: pro-rata
B.allocation: proportional to resting size at the best price
B.min_allocation_semantics: participation floor, not a guaranteed allocation
B.under_allocation_rule: When the aggressor quantity is smaller than the number of eligible resting orders, no order is guaranteed a lot. Pass 1 allocates floor(demand * size_i / total) capped at size_i, which is zero for any order whose share is below one whole lot. Pass 2 awards the remaining lots one at a time by descending fractional remainder, ties broken by lower arrival_sequence. Pass 3 sweeps lots stranded by size caps in arrival_sequence order.

under_allocation_worked_examples.resting: X=1 lot (seq 1), Y=1 lot (seq 2), Z=1 lot (seq 3)
X=1 lot (seq 1), Y=1 lot (seq 2), Z=5 lots (seq 3)

order_flow.state_independence_rationale: The complete intent stream is drawn before any book exists and never consults book state, so both mechanism arms provably consume the same realization and the identity control is a hash comparison rather than a promise.

event_schema.intent_id: Every LIMIT intent carries a unique immutable intent_id assigned at generation. It is the resting order id in every arm.
event_schema.limit_price: book_relative: price = opposite_best - offset * tick for BUY, opposite_best + offset * tick for SELL, with offset drawn uniformly from 1..levels_from_opposite_best at generation and resolved against the arm's own book on arrival. Absolute prices may therefore differ across arms while the intent is identical. If the opposite side is empty on arrival the intent is a counted no-op (limit_no_op) and its intent_id never rests.
event_schema.cancel_target: Every CANCEL intent carries a target_intent_id fixed at generation. For each LIMIT intent i, cancel_at_i = t_i + Exponential(rate = cancel_rate_per_resting_lot_per_sec * size_i), with the hazard fixed at placement on the placed size and never re-drawn after partial fills. A cancel whose target is not resting when it lands, because it was filled, already cancelled or never placed, is a counted no-op (cancel_no_op).
event_schema.market_order: Executes against the arm's own book. An empty opposite side is a counted no-op (market_no_op). Quantity beyond available depth executes the available depth and the remainder lapses.
event_schema.seeded_ladder: The ten initial ladder orders are intents 1..10 at t = 0 at the absolute prices in initial_book_state.ladder, included in the hash, and cancellable under the same hazard.
event_schema.identity_hash_scope: sha256 over the canonical serialization of the full pre-mechanism intent stream (seq, t, kind, side, size, offset, intent_id, target_intent_id). Resolved book coordinates and no-op outcomes are mechanism-dependent by design and are not hashed.
event_schema.horizon_counting: events_per_run_after_warm_up counts intents of all three kinds in the merged time-ordered stream.

participants.background: non-adaptive zero-intelligence agents; sizes drawn from the frozen distribution; no strategic response to mechanism

tracked_agent.style: passive limit at best bid, replenished
tracked_agent.reprice_rule: cancel and replace when best bid moves
tracked_agent.replenishment: cancel and replace to full display size when resting quantity falls below min(display_lots, remaining); topping up loses time priority

participants.declared_limitation: Zero-intelligence agents do not inflate order size. The simulator therefore cannot reproduce strategic size inflation, which is the principal real-world behavioural consequence of pro-rata allocation.

latency.model: per-agent constant one-way latency, no jitter
latency.background_latency_dynamic_effect: none under the frozen non-reactive participant assumption
latency.matched_baseline_meaning: reference cell for the decision metric; no latency parity is claimed, because background latency has no dynamic effect under non-reactive agents

ladder.placement_order: bid level 1, ask level 1, bid level 2, ask level 2, and so on, taking arrival_sequence 1..10

fees.rationale: Maker-taker pricing interacts strongly with pro-rata allocation and would confound the mechanism comparison. Zero fees are frozen and are a declared limitation.

primary.definition: Perold implementation shortfall of the whole parent order, buy side: 1e4 * (sum_i p_i * q_i + (Q - E) * P_T - Q * P_0) / (Q * P_0), where Q is parent_quantity_lots, E is executed lots, (p_i, q_i) are fill price and lots, P_0 is the reference mid at arrival and P_T is the reference mid at the frozen horizon end.
primary.zero_fill_and_timeout_rule: E = 0 gives 1e4 * (P_T - P_0) / P_0, so the run enters the decision statistic as pure opportunity cost. No run is excluded, imputed or treated as missing, and every seed pair is complete by construction.
primary.reference_mid_rule: M(t) is the arm's own mid at the latest instant at or before t at which both book sides were non-empty, initialised to initial_mid_price 1000, which the seeded ladder guarantees at t = 0. P_0 is M at the first measured event and P_T is M after the last measured event. A run whose P_0 or P_T is carried forward is flagged arrival_mid_carried_forward or horizon_mid_carried_forward and retained.
primary.horizon_rule: Every run executes all events_per_run_after_warm_up events regardless of fill state. The horizon end is the frozen event count, never the full-fill time.

primary.definition: size-weighted mean quoted spread at each fill
time_to_first_fill_ms and time_to_full_fill_ms; queue measure is volume_ahead_at_best under FIFO and size_share_at_best under PRO_RATA

comparability.queue_measure: descriptive_only; volume_ahead_at_best is in lots and size_share_at_best is a fraction, so they are different units and are never differenced across mechanisms
comparability.wait_time: time_to_first_fill_ms and time_to_full_fill_ms are the cross-mechanism queue comparison

primary.sampling: queue measure sampled at each placement of the tracked display order; the run value is the mean over placements, and null if the tracked agent never quoted

primary.definition: 1e4 * (P_T - P_0) / P_0 using the same reference mid rule as implementation shortfall

decision_metric.statistic: mean of per-seed paired differences d_s = IS_PRO_RATA(s) - IS_FIFO(s) over the frozen seeds
decision_metric.bootstrap: BCa on the 30 per-seed differences; each resample draws 30 seeds with replacement and recomputes the mean of d_s
decision_metric.interval_alpha_note: Two-sided BCa bootstrap alpha; the 95 percent interval is 1 - alpha. Loaded from here into the bootstrap with no default in code.

identity_run.description: For each seed, the serialized pre-mechanism intent stream must be byte-identical across both mechanisms.
identity_run.verification: Pre-run: sentinel seeds only. Post-run: sha256 equality of the per-run intent-stream digest between mechanisms for every executed (seed, latency, cell) triple in the retained records.
identity_run.state_independent_note: The cancel intensity is applied per intent as a placement-time hazard rather than against live book state, which is what makes the identity claim testable.

zero_latency_control.description: Tracked agent at 0 ms one-way latency: the tracked_agent_one_way_ms = 0 cell of the main grid.
zero_latency_control.background_latency: Background agents are non-reactive zero-intelligence agents and the exogenous stream is defined as the exchange-side arrival process, so background_one_way_ms has no dynamic effect: a uniform shift of the background stream is invisible to every outcome. All agents at 0 ms and tracked agent at 0 ms therefore coincide.

analytic_sanity_case.description: One aggressive market order of 6 lots meets two resting orders at the same price: order X of 2 lots (arrival_sequence 1) and order Y of 10 lots (arrival_sequence 2).

deterministic_replay.description: Re-running from (seed, config) must produce a byte-identical per-run output record.
deterministic_replay.verification: sha256 equality of the per-run JSON record

robustness_cell.change: order_size_distribution_lots replaced by a constant 1 lot for background intents
robustness_cell.purpose: Sets background order size to a constant 1 lot. This removes background size heterogeneity, and also reduces mean background order size from 2.75 to 1.0 lots and lengthens per-order lifetime, so aggregate book depth co-varies. ASSUMPTION_DRIVEN therefore indicates sensitivity to that joint change rather than to size heterogeneity alone. The tracked display order stays at 10 lots, so pro-rata does not reduce to price-time priority in this cell.

NULL.rule: The BCa 95 percent confidence interval of the mean paired difference at the matched-latency baseline contains zero.

UNSTABLE.rule: Evaluated only when NULL does not hold. Let n_plus and n_minus be the counts of strictly positive and strictly negative per-seed differences at the matched baseline, excluding exact zeros. UNSTABLE holds when the exact two-sided binomial sign test of n_plus against n_minus gives p greater than 0.05.
UNSTABLE.alpha_note: Two-sided exact binomial sign test significance level. Loaded from here; no default exists in code.

LATENCY_DRIVEN.rule: Evaluated only when NULL does not hold. Let D5 be the point estimate at the matched baseline and D0 the paired point estimate at the zero-latency control. Holds when the paired BCa 95 percent interval at 0 ms contains zero AND the absolute value of D0 is at most 0.5 times the absolute value of D5.

ASSUMPTION_DRIVEN.rule: As LATENCY_DRIVEN, with the constant_order_size robustness cell at the matched baseline in place of the zero-latency cell.

negative_result_criteria.reporting: criteria_met lists every label that holds. The headline verdict is the first held label in precedence order. NULL is exclusive by construction because the other labels are conditioned on NULL not holding.

environment_lock.install_command: python -m pip install --require-hashes -r microstructure-sim/requirements.lock.txt && python -m pip install -e microstructure-sim --no-deps --no-build-isolation
environment_lock.verified_before_run: reproduce refuses to start unless an authorisation receipt approves this contract id at exactly the freeze tag and HEAD SHA with a clean working tree and a byte-identical contract, the interpreter matches the frozen series, this file matches the recorded digest, and every installed distribution matches the pins
environment_lock.runtime_identity_scope: major.minor is enforced before the run; CI pins an exact patch and the run receipt records the full version. No claim is made that the patch level is enforced outside CI.

required: all five primary metrics for every cell
count and description of retained degenerate runs
at least three retained failure or edge-case runs
prohibited: any claim that either mechanism is a superior market design
cross-reference to unrelated prior auction or mechanism-design work by the builder

claim_boundary: Synthetic simulation only. Conclusions are valid solely for the two frozen mechanisms under this frozen order-flow process, participant assumptions, latency model and fee schedule. This is not evidence of real-market performance, realized returns, predictive alpha, profitability, market-quality superiority, or exchange deployability.

authorization.predicate: receipt.approved is exactly boolean true; no string prefix is accepted
authorization.reviewed_sha_rule: full 40-character SHA, and it must be HEAD exactly; an ancestor is not accepted, because a commit after review is not covered by the review. The receipt must also name the reviewed tag, which must equal authority.freeze_tag and resolve through refs/tags/ to exactly the named SHA. The gate further refuses unless the working tree is clean apart from the receipt, the contract in use sits at its canonical repository path and is byte-identical to the blob committed at that SHA, and the executing mechsim package lies inside that worktree. The import path must also contain reviewed files and nothing else, because verifying source does not prove which bytecode the interpreter runs.
authorization.contract_line_endings: lf, pinned by .gitattributes, because the gate compares the contract on disk with the committed blob byte for byte
authorization.grant_scope: a validated receipt adds the contract id to sim.AUTHORISED_CONTRACTS for the current process; run_once honours allow_frozen_seed=True only for a contract id in that set, so the flag alone executes nothing
authorization.contract_confirmatory_status_is_frozen: confirmatory_status stays NOT_AUTHORIZED_PENDING_INDEPENDENT_PRE_RUN_REVIEW permanently. Authorisation is granted by the receipt, so the reviewed contract and the executed contract are the same bytes and the validator never has to change to permit a run.
authorization.reviewer_identity: The receipt's reviewer field is free text. There is no signature, no key and no identity check: the gate records who the receipt claims the reviewer was, and proves nothing about it. Receipt provenance is a paperwork control, not a cryptographic one.
